POST /api/waitlist duplicate email returns same id with 'already on the list' message (idempotent)
POST /api/waitlist invalid email returns 422 with pydantic email validation error
GET /api/waitlist/count returns integer count (2) matching created entries
GET /api/waitlist returns entry list with no _id leak (only id/name/email/address/baby_name/baby_age/created_at)
Frontend loads at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and hero-section text 'The deepest' visible after animation
site-nav visible; nav-cta click scrolls page (0 -> 7654px) to waitlist section
waitlist-form renders all 5 inputs + submit (name, email, baby-name, address, baby-age, submit)
Valid submission shows waitlist-success card with 'Position #3' and welcome message; sonner toast appears
Duplicate email submission shows success card with 'already on the list' style message + matching toast
Empty submit (only name filled) surfaces toast and preserves entered form value (not cleared)
All required sections rendered in DOM: chapter-01/02/03, categories-section, hyderabad-banner, how-section, site-footer
notes: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env is https://mumzo-hyderabad.preview.emergentagent.com (different from URL in review request); used the .env value as instructed. Framer-motion animations settle within ~2.5s. No console errors observed.
